courses.prerequisiteText: Completion of Certificate in Indigenous Language Proficiency; or with permission of instructor.
courses.description: Aimed at building conversational and narrative fluency and proficiency in a particular Indigenous language. courses.prerequisiteText: or Corequisite: INLG 300 or permission of instructor.

courses.title: INLG Immersion IV
courses.prerequisiteText: INLG (or FNLG) 358; or permission of instructor.
courses.description: Continuation of intensive immersion "on the land" led by elder or fluent speaker in an Indigenous language at a high intermediate to early advanced level. Exposes learners to a variety of authentic situations where the language is used and spoken in everyday tasks. May be taken again when offered in another Indigenous language.
